Commentary.Commentary: ... DAY 3, SESSION 3 ...

For Lanka, Asitha was the star but he was well supported by Kumara, Jayasuriya and Vishwa. They shared the wickets amongst them and have helped Lanka gain a massive lead. However, LANKA HAVE NOT EFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON AND WILL BE BATTING AGAIN! They'll start with a lead of 353. Join us after the break in a bit.

Time for the Tea break too! Yet again a poor display with the bat by Bangladesh and they have been bowled out for below 200 yet again. Zakir Hasan was the only one who managed a half ton and that is what you do not need when you have a big deficit. They needed a few of them who got starts to kick on but that was not the case. They find themselves way, way behind in the game yet again.

That was some bowling performance from the visitors. Bangladesh played the first hour watchfully. Zakir Hasan and Taijul Islam showed character initially. There were a couple of edges that fell short of slips and Sri Lanka just needed some luck their way. It arrived once Vishwa Fernando came into the attack. He bowled a serious spell with great pace. He got both set batters and Prabath Jayasuriya got the wicket of the skipper. Bangladesh fumbled with the bat in the past. They have Shakib this time around but and he have to showcase his experience with the bat. The cracks have started to open up and it would only get difficult for Bangladesh to bat now. Let's see how they play the second session.

Bangladesh in reply lost Joy in the small passage of play but with the pitch still decent enough to bat, the hosts will be expected to dominate the day. However Sri Lanka will hope to make early inroads. Their bowlers are fresh as compared to Bangladeshi batters. Let’s see how the first session pans out.

Sri Lanka on the other hand, need to be patient. The wicket isn't offering much and they'll look to hit the right lines and lengths on consistent basis. Discipline will be the key for them and they'll hope they can execute their plans with the ball. Day 3 is an important one and we hope you join us for the coverage. Until then, goodbye and take care!

Bangladesh can be happy with how they've started! They would have loved to end the day without losing a wicket but they'll be pleased how the openers played against the new ball. Joy fell right at the end but Hasan has looked good and they would hope they can continue the good work on Day 3.
